transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before we proceed with the delivery package approval for "Midnight Arcade," I want to make sure we've completed the department-by-department signoff. We have rights, post-production, and publicity all in the room — so let's work through any required changes from each department before I sign off on the final package. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I reviewed the countersigned music license this morning. The concert may be distributed only in the United States and Canada — so the worldwide delivery listing needs to be changed to U.S. and Canada only. Additionally, the required music credit must be exactly 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs,' which differs from the standard music credit currently listed in the package.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue from post-production. I received the broadcaster's completed ingest test today and confirmed that delivery must be an IMF package at 25 fps with English SDH captions. The current draft package lists a 4K UHD 24 fps master and an ordinary English subtitle file — both will fail the partner's ingest specification. We need to update the package to specify an IMF package at 25 fps and English SDH captions before Mara signs off.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a change required from publicity. I confirmed with the artist's representative this afternoon that publicity for 'Midnight Arcade' is embargoed until June 21. The representative will reject any public release dated earlier than June 21. The current draft package lists a June 14 publicity release, which conflicts with the embargo — we need to update the publicity release date to June 21 before Mara approves the package.
transcript.speaker: A4

decisions.music_credit: Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs

commitments.detail: Update territories to U.S. and Canada only, music credit to 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs,' master format to IMF package at 25 fps, caption format to English SDH captions, and publicity release date to June 21.
